findings.issue: No backup strategy for Supabase Storage files (chat-uploads bucket — avatars and file uploads)
findings.impact: All user-uploaded content (avatars, shared files) has zero backup — complete data loss if storage bucket is corrupted or deleted
findings.fix: Create script to export Supabase Storage bucket to DO Spaces or S3 on a schedule; document restore procedure

findings.issue: No restore test evidence exists — no documented restore drill procedure, no scripts, no evidence of any restore being tested
findings.impact: Backup may be non-functional or incomplete; first restore attempt will be during a real outage
findings.fix: Write and execute a quarterly restore drill; document procedure; create restore script

findings.issue: RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective) not defined anywhere in the codebase
findings.impact: No recovery expectations documented — operators cannot determine if recovery is 'fast enough'
findings.fix: Define RTO (e.g., 4 hours) and RPO (e.g., 1 hour) based on business requirements; document in runbook

findings.issue: No dedicated backup runbook in docs/runbooks/ — Supabase PITR mentioned only in passing in migration runbook
findings.impact: Operators lack step-by-step backup/restore guidance during incident
findings.fix: Create docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md with: Supabase PITR procedure, storage bucket export, full DR (droplet loss) recovery

findings.issue: No automated Supabase backup verification — no script to check that daily Supabase backup completed successfully
findings.impact: Backup failures go unnoticed until restore is attempted — worst-case: no valid backup exists
findings.fix: Add daily cron job or GitHub scheduled workflow to check Supabase backup status via API

findings.issue: No pg_dump or Supabase export scripts exist — only relies on Supabase managed backups
findings.impact: No offline backup available if Supabase service is unavailable
findings.fix: Add scripts/pg_dump.sh or scripts/export-supabase.sh for on-demand or scheduled export

findings.issue: No full disaster recovery runbook covering total droplet loss scenario
findings.impact: If the DO droplet is lost, operators must reconstruct recovery steps from multiple scattered documents
findings.fix: Create full DR runbook: Terraform init -> apply -> restore DB via PITR -> restore storage -> smoke test

findings.issue: Docker HEALTHCHECK succeeded but no application-level smoke test after restore
findings.impact: Restore can pass health check while critical features are still broken (auth, messaging, realtime)
findings.fix: Add smoke test step to restore runbook: verify auth flow, message send, WebSocket connect, file access

findings.issue: Terraform state has no DR backup plan — DO Spaces bucket has no cross-region replication configured
findings.impact: If DO Spaces bucket is lost, Terraform state is unrecoverable — infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch
findings.fix: Document Terraform state recovery: import existing resources from cloud provider; consider state bucket replication
